blind.description: A small wooden crate holding apothecary supplies: a large round dark green glass demijohn flask with a cork stopper and wicker-wrapped base, two white ceramic jars with gold stripes and golden lid knobs, and a tied bundle of dried herbs nestled inside the crate. Stylized, clean hand-painted video game asset quality with solid continuous geometry and no floating pieces.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden crate frame enclosing a large round dark green circle with a cork cap, two small round white and gold jar lids side-by-side, and a leafy herb bundle tucked alongside.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
